phase_0.domain_name: A Lean 4 proof artifact implementing the Collatz conjecture proof skeleton: 2-adic valuation frames with well-founded lexicographic descent. The proof opens the domain (⊢), defines the Collatz map self-referentially (⊙), splits on 2-adic valuation (∈), deposits even-step descent (⊤) and odd-step valuation increase (⊥), fuses valuation frames (∋), fixes winding as valuation (◻), closes by well-founded order (⊣).
phase_0.boundary_condition: The well-founded lexicographic order on pairs (v₂(n), n) for n ∈ ℕ⁺, which guarantees termination of the 2-adic valuation descent.

⊢.justification: The domain ℕ⁺ is the initial object — all Collatz trajectories begin here, uninitialized before any valuation is extracted.

⊣.justification: The lexicographic order on (v₂(n), n) is the terminal anchor — it contains all trajectories and guarantees every sequence reaches (0,1).

≻.justification: Forward morphism: n → n/2 strictly decreases n while preserving or resetting valuation — the descent arm.

≺.justification: Reverse/contravariant morphism: n → (3n+1)/2 appears to expand n but strictly increases 2-adic valuation — the apparent ascent that actually advances winding.

⋈.justification: Sequential composition of Collatz steps — each step feeds into the next, chaining even and odd transitions along the trajectory.

⊙.justification: Self-referential definition: col(n) = n/2 if even else (3n+1)/2 — the map is its own specification, recursively defined on its output.

∈.justification: Splits the proposition 'n eventually reaches 1' into two cases: even n and odd n. The frame opens on the universal claim ∀n, trajectory reaches 1.

∋.justification: Fuses the even and odd case proofs back into the single proven proposition 'n eventually reaches 1'. Both arms prove the same claim for their respective cases.

⊤.justification: Affirmative arm: for even n, n/2 < n and by induction n/2 reaches 1, so n reaches 1.

⊥.justification: Negative arm: for odd n, v₂(3n+1) > 0 so the trajectory increases valuation; by well-founded order on (v₂, n), it eventually reaches an even number and descends.

⊞.justification: Paradice state: the proposition holds for both even and odd n simultaneously — the universal claim is constructively true for all n.

◻.justification: Irreversible fixation: the 2-adic valuation v₂(n) is the winding number. Each frame closure permanently records one winding advance. The sequence of valuations is the measurement record.

steps.domain_action: open domain of positive integers ℕ⁺
define Collatz map col(n) = n/2 if even else (3n+1)/2
split proposition '∀n, trajectory reaches 1' into even/odd cases
even case — n/2 < n, by induction n/2 reaches 1, so n reaches 1
odd case — v₂(3n+1) > 0, valuation increases, well-founded order guarantees eventual even step
both cases hold — universal proposition true for all n
rejoin case proofs into single proven proposition
record winding — valuation is the winding number
reverse/check — trajectory must eventually reach valuation 0 (powers of 2)
advance — from valuation 0, even steps descend to 1
compose case proofs into full universal proof
close by well-founded lexicographic order on (v₂(n), n)

phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Lexicographic order on (v₂(n), n) determines case priority — even case when v₂ > 0, odd case when v₂ = 0
phase_5.alfs_store: The Collatz map col(n) itself — self-referential bootstrap (IMSCRIB)

phase_6.cycle_cost: One valuation extraction per case (v₂ computation)
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Universal proposition proven, all cases closed
